stories.title: FULL DOCUMENTARY | Protecting Kahoolawe: 50 Years of Aloha Aina
stories.summary: The full documentary “Protecting Kahoʻolawe: 50 Years of Aloha ʻĀina” is streaming tonight on the Hawaii News Now livestream.

stories.title: H-POWER fuel spill timeline reveals gaps in data and communication
stories.summary: Records and officials’ statements show how the H-POWER spill estimate grew and when Honolulu’s mayor and Hawaiʻi’s governor learned of its scale.

stories.title: Rainbow Wahine prepare to face New Mexico in Mountain West Tournament opener
stories.summary: First serve against New Mexico is scheduled for Tuesday at 11 a.m. HST.

stories.title: Maui families rally to change student-athlete transfer policy
stories.summary: Student-athletes and their supporters stood outside King Kekaulike High School in Pukalani to demand changes to a Maui Interscholastic League policy.

stories.title: Mayor pitches baseball’s return to Old Stadium Park
stories.summary: Tentative plans call for bleachers that can seat up to 6,500 people and adequate parking at the Moilili park.

stories.title: Hawaii launches low-cost loan program to help homeowners convert cesspools
stories.summary: The program, established under Act 204 of 2026, is supported by funding from Hawaii’s Green Fee and is now accepting applications.

stories.title: Police chief-elect indicted on child sex charges
stories.summary: The man who ran unopposed for chief of police in a Louisiana village has been indicted on four child sex charges.

stories.title: Federal judge orders ex-police chief to disclose finances over unpaid civil judgment
stories.summary: Louis Kealoha must answer questions under oath as relatives seek to collect a $500,000 judgment stemming from a fraud case.

stories.title: Pain into purpose: Female police recruits share why they signed up for HPD
stories.summary: One recruit opened up about the terrible crime she faced as a child which later motivated her.

stories.title: Court hearing delayed for Hawaii Island father accused of killing infant son
stories.summary: Joshua Paiva and his attorney are expected to return to court Wednesday, Nov. 25, at 2 p.m.

stories.title: Virgin Voyages announces first Hawaii cruise aboard Brilliant Lady in 2028
stories.summary: A cruise line known for its adults-only voyages and boutique hotel-style experience is heading to Hawaii for the first time.

stories.title: Investigation opens into funeral home after family told body can’t be found
stories.summary: The Louisiana State Board of Embalmers and Funeral Directors has opened an investigation into Heavenly Gates Funeral Home after the funeral home told a family it could not find their loved one’s body.
